title: The Reason Why You Should Build A Personal AI
description:
Geoff Woods reveals the ultimate AI cheat code.

He didn't just build a custom AI persona to help him build his business, he programs an exact replica of the man he wants to be in the future.

He consults this advisor every single day to eliminate short-term decision fatigue so your long-term trajectory becomes impossible to mess up.
